content.title: Hailey Bieber Shares Rare Cuddly Snap with 19-Month-Old Son Jack Blues
content.text: Hailey Bieber ; Hailey cuddling up with her son, Jack Blues. Credit : Jamie McCarthy/WireImage; Hailey Bieber/Instagram NEED TO KNOW Hailey Bieber shared a rare photo of her 19-month-old son, Jack Blues Bieber, on Instagram on Sunday, March 22The model shares Jack with husband Justin Bieber but the pair tend to keep their family life privateHailey recently revealed her pregnancy with Jack came as a surprise because she had previously been diagnosed with a uterine septum Hailey Bieber has shared an adorable photo with her son, Jack Blues Bieber! The model, 29, uploaded a carousel of pictures to her Instagram account on Sunday, March 22, which included a sweet image of her cuddling her rarely seen 19-month-old boy. The mom of one had her brunette hair tied back and wore a cozy hooded sweatshirt as she nuzzled her head into Jack's, showing a glimpse of his short, fair hair in the candid snap. Hailey simply captioned her post: “Different faces and places 🌻.” Hailey Bieber snuggling with her son, Jack Blues Bieber. Hailey Bieber/Instagram It marks one of the few times that the Rhode founder has publicly shared intimate family moments with her 55.8 million Instagram followers. Other snaps in the photo dump included stylish pictures of her wearing full glam while posing in her bathroom mirror, as well as shots of her experimenting with blond hair. Hailey was also snapped cuddling with an elephant blanket. Hailey Bieber/Instagram Hailey shares Jack with her husband, Justin Bieber, 32. The couple — who live in Los Angeles, California — welcomed their little boy into the world in August 22, 2024 The adorable photograph comes as Hailey recently revealed that her pregnancy came as a surprise, as she had previously been diagnosed with a uterine septum — a condition that increases miscarriage and preterm delivery risks. The entrepreneur spoke on the SHE MD podcast on March 3, alongside co-hosts Dr. Thaïs Aliabadi, who is also Hailey’s OB/GYN, and Mary Alice Haney. Related Stories “Yeah. So I had a septum in my uterus, and Dr. [Aliabadi] kept saying, ‘Well, we need to look at this and keep an eye on it before you get pregnant because it could potentially be an issue,' " recalled Hailey. "And I was like, ‘Okay. Well, I’m not thinking about getting pregnant right now, so we’ll just cross that bridge when we get there.’ And then I magically got pregnant.” “And then she calls me, and she’s like, ‘I’m pregnant!’ And I’m like, ‘No!’ ” said Dr. Aliabadi. Haney then asked Dr. Aliabadi to explain what a uterine septum is and what the risks are that are associated with it. Hailey and Justin Bieber at BMO Stadium on March 21. Kevin Mazur/Getty Despite the health scare, Hailey and Justin have said they are open to expanding their family. During an appearance on the In Your Dreams podcast in October of last year, the beauty founder told host Owen Thiele that she "definitely" wants more kids. "I know I want more than one," she shared. "I always knew I wanted to be a mom, though. Since I was a little kid, I always envisioned myself having kids," Hailey continued. "You know what's funny? The older I've gotten and now that I have a kid, I think any decision anyone makes about having them or not having them is totally amazing."
